motivation: R4 measured a_xy and f_norm on the final snapshot while the stress they explain is a steady-window time average; snapshot coordination deviates from the time average by up to 14.2% (R4 leg B). R4 named this the prime suspect for its systematic +31% dense-end overshoot but did not quantify it. R5 measures the same constants as time averages inside the same window as the stress.
what_changes: fabric estimator (snapshot -> steady-window time average); the apparatus, grid, seeds and kappa are unchanged from R4

predictions.statement: with time-averaged fabric a_xy is concentration independent
predictions.rule: max/min - 1 of the per-phi mean a_xy over the 3 concentrations <= 0.15

predictions.statement: with the measured f_norm time average, f_norm is concentration independent
predictions.rule: max/min - 1 of the per-phi mean f_norm over the 3 concentrations <= 0.15

predictions.statement: two time-averaged constants predict the independent R2 map out of sample
predictions.rule: |A_pred/A_meas - 1| <= 0.15 on every gated R2 point with phi >= 0.71

predictions.statement: the single snapshot is a biased fabric estimator (R4's suspicion, tested as a number rather than a narrative)
predictions.rule: |a_xy_snapshot/a_xy_timeavg - 1| >= 0.0625 (the seed-noise floor) on at least 5 of the 9 runs

predictions.statement: the factored structural identity survives with time-averaged inputs
predictions.rule: |A_pred_factored/A_normal - 1| <= 0.15 on every run, with every input a steady-window time average

honesty_rules: the R2 map is prediction-only: its points are never refitted or re-run here
the apparatus is unchanged; if P1-P3 fail the factorisation is reported as FAIL and the time-average hypothesis is recorded as falsified
seed noise is reported next to every spread so a spread below the noise floor is not read as a resolved physical trend

one point (phi=0.80, seed 20261112) was inspected while smoke-testing the new simulator option, before this pre-registration was written; the predictions below are structural (ledger tolerance, noise floor) and were not tuned on it
